item.title: Flash floods devastate Nepal-Tibet region; hundreds of tourists unaccounted for
item.description:
Flash floods and a mudslide along the Nepal-Tibet border have killed at least nine people, with hundreds of tourists reported missing, officials said. The Bhote Koshi River surged past its banks, sweeping away homes, roads, bridges and hydropower facilities. Rescue helicopters have been unable to reach the worst-hit areas as authorities in both countries brace for the death toll to rise further.

item.title: No more rhinestones: Dolly Parton's family releases her final farewell message
item.description:
Dolly Parton's family has shared the country icon's final message, "I will always love you," in a tribute video posted to her official Instagram account. Her nephew, Bryan Seaver, who serves as her longtime head of security, confirmed that Parton herself had asked him years ago to deliver the announcement. The family said a private funeral will be held per Parton's wishes, while inviting fans to leave public tributes online.

item.title: Nvidia earnings loom as Hormuz optimism drags oil lower across Asia
item.description:
Asian equity markets rose Wednesday as falling oil prices and growing optimism over a possible Strait of Hormuz reopening pulled bond yields lower, Reuters reported. Investors also braced for Nvidia's second-quarter earnings, a report widely seen as a key test of whether the AI spending boom can keep delivering profits. Currency markets held steady ahead of US inflation data and the Federal Reserve's Jackson Hole symposium.
